Hello! Welcome to my wacky silly rock game. Sign ups will open at 9 EST (unless reveal takes longer than I expect, then 9:30). It is first come, first serve. People who did not play last season will be prioritized for the first hour or so. If you played last season, feel free to sign up within the first hour, but if we do end up with more than [however many people are on the cast idk yet] in that window, the most recent person to sign up and play last season will be booted. To read the rules, please see the attached document (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vFHvN2WnLZijmRBpj2udgAbDu8m7aMM-EFbR6awSelY/edit?usp=sharing). For a brief, tl;dr, please read the following: -During challenge periods, explore a custom made map of Hyrule! Your goal is to be the first to clear all eight dungeons, and there is a special reward for the first person to do so. -In order to explore the map, you will be given ten actions (this number may increase as the game goes on). You can move or interact with the tile you are on. Moving does exactly that, while interacting will search the tile. You may encounter some money, hearts, scary enemies, or something a little more special. -Voting is largely independent from the exploration system. However, if you are quick to clearing a dungeon, you may be rewarded with items or trinkets that you can use to your benefit in the rock game (advantages). -Other than that, this functions just like every other rock game. Voting will take place in a thread, and all discussion on votes will be contained to this channel. (edited)
Hyrockule Rules Doc

10:19 AM
Hello friends of the jury. I won't mince words here. I firmly believe I am the deserving winner of Hyrockrule. Let's for a moment look at some of the qualities of a deserving rock game victor. I think after doing so, you will see I am the clear choice. What makes a good rock game victor, you ask? A good rock game victor is not afraid of leading the charge: I went to 2 pre-merge tribals where I picked the voting target in both instances. Even leading the vote in the perilous double elimination in the starting vote to the season, putting myself in grave danger of going home but still weaseling out of it. During the merge, I was first to vote or attempted to form voting coalitions in multiple votes and while they did not always end up in the player's elimination (see: A Person at F11 and again at F6), I did not fear playing visibly and aggressively. A good rock game victor gets lucky: This one is easy, I took the most penalty rocks for voted out players of my fellow FTC castaways (three) and yet here I sit in front of you, a testament to my resilience. I also expertly navigated winning immunity at F6 and F5. A good rock game victor is their own player: I had many allies throughout this game at different points. Tomfy, Kiara, Camryn, Pigeon, Cetus, Sherlock even my fellow FTC-mate, Willow. But no one can accuse me of ever being a follower. I took my own path to FTC which included necessary cuts to friends as well as forging my own path even when allies disagreed with me. This, above all else in my opinion is the reason I think I've earned your vote. I played my game and nobody else's. I think that game was played visibly, honorably, and strategically with a healthy dose of luck for good measure. And I think that game deserves your respect and therefore your vote. Thank you for reading and I look forward to questions!
